recommendation: Authorize one bounded isolated issuer-core feasibility prototype, retaining NO-GO for R3/R4/caller adoption until complete hook/storage/compatibility proof; no production fork adoption

alternatives.name: Bounded owned issuer-core prototype
alternatives.consequence: Adds version-specific experimental core patch design/build ownership. No promise of acceptance; a negative result keeps authority unavailable. Long-term maintenance/deployment remains separate.

alternatives.name: Keep stock issuer and capability unavailable
alternatives.consequence: No owned issuer patch work. Existing identity/conditional acquisition and dependent migration acceptance stay open until supported hooks or a separately accepted alternative exist.

decision_scope: If accepted, supersedes extension-only implementation direction in proposed ADR0002/0003, not their invariants, old failure oracles, current guards or Temporal/runtime ownership
required_patch_boundaries: Mandatory trusted enrollment and native auth/grant/alternate entry denial
Fresh immutable snapshot independent of request caches and AUTO flush
All protected model/bulk/native/provider/background writer participation or enforceable exclusion before reads
Atomic generation/tombstone/recovery and attempt lifecycle on issuer primary transaction
Native signing/mappers fixed profile and synchronous durable-commit-before-response boundary
Build augmentation, paired issuer mapping/Liquibase, protected recovery configuration and immutable provider admission
